COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Network Troubleshooting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Troubleshooting.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Troubleshooting.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Network Troubleshooting.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Troubleshooting.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cybersecurity.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cybersecurity.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

11. When learning Data Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
